author: KojaCola
body:
A couple of weeks ago, CronicMC started calling me "jap" ( a very offensive term for a Japanese person (such as myself)) and I logged off upset but not very much affected. Today, I went online only to find CronicMC calling me "jap" again without me saying anything. I asked him very politely to refrain from calling me "jap" but he kept on going. I was fed up with this so I went into the other game where I knew a mod was and called him/her over. He/she had a discussion and ended with a  kick. CronicMC insulted the mod afterwards. 

The mod was- FrostedCupcakez.

Thank you for reading this. I hope this can be dealt with.

Kojapan17
